outcome: physiologic indices (pulse rate, systolic blood pressure, diastolic blood pressure, respiratory rate, temperature)
cohort: Twenty women hospitalized in the Obstetrics Department of Imam Reza Hospital, Kermanshah, Iran, following cesarean delivery.
finding: Foot reflexology was found to be a useful and effective non-pharmacological method for decreasing pain and adjusting physiologic indices (respiratory rate, temperature, pulse rate, and blood pressure) in women after cesarean delivery.
